home_hero_lead: Where the harmonizing wisdom of traditional herbal medicine meets modern bioscience. Health foods made to Japanese quality standards, from Kanshodo.
home_philosophy_title: Unchanged by the passing years, like the pine.
home_philosophy_body: Kanshodo brings together the wisdom of traditional herbal medicine, handed down over centuries, with cutting-edge bioscience. Our mission is to build a “hall of health” that supports your well-being every day.
business_brand_body: Under the KANSHODO brand we plan and sell health foods that unite herbal wisdom with modern science. Every product is manufactured in GMP-certified factories in Japan.
business_oem_body: From formulation design and package design to manufacturing in Japanese factories, we handle the entire health food development process as a one-stop partner.
product_summary: 45,000 mg of NMN per bottle, combined with reduced coenzyme Q10 made by Kaneka. A 90-day supply, manufactured in a GMP-certified factory in Japan.
home_contact_body: For product questions or OEM / ODM inquiries, please feel free to get in touch.
philosophy_lead: The harmonizing wisdom of herbal medicine and modern bioscience, under one roof.
greeting_title: True health and beauty from within, evergreen like the pine.
business_lead: Planning and selling our own brand, and OEM / ODM contract manufacturing. Through these two businesses we deliver health foods of Japanese quality.
oem_step1_body: We discuss your product concept, target market, expected volume and budget.
oem_step2_body: We design ingredients and dosages for your goals and select the dosage form (tablet, capsule, etc.).
oem_step3_body: We design packaging and labels that match your brand, and review the labeling requirements.
oem_step4_body: Products are manufactured in a GMP-certified factory in Japan, inspected and delivered.
oem_cta_body: We also welcome small-lot projects and products for overseas markets. Please feel free to contact us.
feature1_body: Designed to provide 500 mg of NMN in two tablets a day. The β-nicotinamide mononucleotide is made in Japan.
feature2_body: Contains 20 mg of reduced coenzyme Q10 manufactured by Kaneka Corporation per two tablets.
feature3_title: Made in a GMP-certified factory in Japan
feature3_body: From receiving ingredients to manufacturing and shipping, everything is managed at a GMP-certified factory in Japan.
spec_ingredients_value: β-Nicotinamide mononucleotide (made in Japan), reduced coenzyme Q10 preparation (reduced coenzyme Q10, dextrin) / HPMC, cellulose, calcium stearate, stabilizer (acacia gum), colorant (titanium dioxide), antioxidant (vitamin C), lecithin (from soy)
spec_usage_value: Take about 2 tablets a day with water or lukewarm water.
spec_storage_value: Store at room temperature, away from direct sunlight, heat and humidity.
product_note: This product is a food. Discontinue use if it does not agree with you.
